content.title: Federal tax filing deadline extended for Mississippians due to Jan. winter storm impacts
content.text: Skip to contentShareAdd Us On GoogleAdd as a preferred source on GoogleBILOXI, Miss. (WLOX) — The federal tax deadline is postponed for all Mississippi residents until June 8, 2026.The Internal Revenue Service (IRS) announced the last-minute federal tax relief on Tuesday, one day before Tax Day. The extension comes as a result of the January winter storm that affected thousands of Mississippians, leaving them without power for weeks.Certain federal deadlines that fall between Jan. 23 and June 8, including various individual and business tax returns and tax payments, will be granted additional time. The extension also applies to quarterly payroll and certain excise tax returns and deposits.See the full IRS press release below: As of the time of publication of this article, Mississippi state taxes are still due April 15.See a spelling or grammar error in this story?
